description: A spawn under a key in use stops the running child (its cancel step's emitted event is stale) and starts the new one. A send to a child spawned in the same step finds it not started yet and is undelivered with `to` null, as is a send to a key with no child; a stop of a key with no child does nothing. Two spawns under one key in a step start only the second. A spawn in the step that ends the hub never starts, and the children still running are stopped in the order they started.
